description: This file contains JUnit test cases for validating the TestOrderValidator class within the OpenMRS project. It specifically tests validation logic for the specimenSource field in TestOrder objects, ensuring proper handling of valid and invalid concepts.

classes.name: TestOrderValidatorTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for TestOrderValidator, extending BaseContextSensitiveTest for integration with the context and database.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfTheSpecimenSourceIsInvalid
methods.description: Tests that validation correctly fails when the specimenSource concept is not among allowed drug routes.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfTheSpecimenSourceIsValid
methods.description: Tests that validation passes when the specimenSource concept is valid and among allowed concepts.
